statements.statement: The paper has been retracted, after the authors found a coding error in the analysis that invalidates the main result.
The paper's main result was that 1000 IU daily vitamin D raised hip bone density by 2.1% over a year in 300 women aged 65+, but the reported 2.1% increase was not reproducible.
No draft was uploaded for this project, so this assessment is general, for a typical researcher who relies on the paper's main result.
The paper has been retracted after the authors found a coding error that invalidates the main result.
The main result was 1000 IU daily vitamin D raising hip bone density 2.1% over a year in 300 women aged 65+, but the 2.1% increase was not reproducible.
Any argument resting on the 2.1% finding would be seriously affected, so impact would be high for a researcher citing it as key evidence.
The paper has been retracted after the authors found a coding error that invalidates the main result, and the reported 2.1% increase was not reproducible.
